value.rationale: The current source output preserves two prohibitions with the same actor, disclosure action, condition, and clause support: the source-supported prohibition carrying both written-authorization and required-purpose exceptions, and an invalid no-exceptions shadow. The repair performs a narrow reconciliation after acquisition: it removes only a co-supported no_exceptions prohibition when an otherwise identical prohibition expressly retains both authorization_exception and purpose_exception. The qualified prohibition and its exact evidence remain unchanged; unrelated prohibitions, permissions, disposal duties, retention rules, residuals, and unreviewed fields are unaffected.
